jei.jaymospowers.chain_axe: An axe head on a length of chain. Hold right click to whirl it round you, and let go to throw it at what you look at, up to nine blocks. The head stays buried in whoever it hits and the haft is useless until it is out: right click beside them to work it free, or from further off to rip it out by the chain for a second wound. Put the axe away while it is buried and the haft falls to the ground, still chained to the head. Forged at the Tool Station from a Chain Axe Head, a Tool Handle and an iron chain.
